verdict.rationale: Weaviate's replication-architecture docs say it replicates data across a multi-node cluster when the replication factor is set above 1, and they name high availability as a benefit. That covers the core of node-level replication for HA. The evidence pack does not show any consistency model (tunable consistency, quorum, eventual consistency) or zone-aware replication. Missing for 10: documented consistency model, cross-zone/rack-aware replication evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can replicate data across nodes or zones for high availability with a documented consistency model

citations.quote: Weaviate allows data replication across a multi-node cluster by setting a replication factor > 1. This enables a variety of benefits such as high availability
